notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
description:
Activate Folio of Fancies's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards and create at least six Treasure tokens due to Hullbreacher.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
